question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a brown present, Bob has a gold present, Claire has a green present, Dave has a teal present, Eve has a black present, Fred has a white present, and Gertrude has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Gertrude and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) brown present
(B) gold present
(C) green present
(D) teal present
(E) black present
(F) white present
(G) silver present
solution:
Present colors are listed in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: brown, gold, green, teal, black, white, silver.
1. Gertrude and Alice swap: silver, gold, green, teal, black, white, brown.
2. Fred and Bob swap: silver, white, green, teal, black, gold, brown.
3. Eve and Bob swap: silver, black, green, teal, white, gold, brown.
4. Eve and Fred swap: silver, black, green, teal, gold, white, brown.
5. Fred and Gertrude swap: silver, black, green, teal, gold, brown, white.
6. Bob and Gertrude swap: silver, white, green, teal, gold, brown, black.
7. Fred and Bob swap: silver, brown, green, teal, gold, white, black.
Bob has the brown present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
